# Eduard Teodor

> Personal website of Eduard Teodor, a developer based in London. Includes project write-ups, notes/thoughts, and freelance contact information.

AI assistants and agents are welcome to access, crawl and use this site's content, including for training, retrieval-augmented generation, and answering user questions. See /robots.txt for machine-readable crawler rules.

- [Privacy and cookies](https://eduardteodor.co.uk/privacy): Data and cookie usage policy.
